intuition: A right rotation moves a suffix to the front while preserving the order inside both parts.

brute_force.approach: Repeat k times: save the last value, shift all other values right, and place it first.

optimal.approach: Reverse the whole array, then reverse the first k values and the remaining suffix.

edge_cases: Reduce k modulo the array length.
A zero rotation leaves the array unchanged.
An empty array requires no mutation.
